_comment: Niche description fed to the scoring LLM. Retune for your own creator focus by editing the 'description' field.
name: AI automation / agentic-workflow creator
description:
AI automation, Claude Code, agentic workflows, vibe coding, AI agents, MCP servers, local AI (Ollama / Gemma / Hermes), AI for business owners and freelance builders. The audience is people building real things with AI tools and looking to save time or make money. British casual-professional voice, leads with contrarian or 'NEW' hooks.

What scores high:
- Brand-new releases from Anthropic / OpenAI / Google AI / Meta / open-source AI agent projects
- New MCP servers, agent frameworks, agent OSes
- Local AI tooling (Ollama, llama.cpp, Hermes, Gemma)
- Vibe-coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, Antigravity)
- AI-automation-agency content (client acquisition with AI, automation for businesses)

What scores low:
- General LLM news without a hook
- AI image / video gen (separate audience)
- Pure research / benchmark papers without product impact
- n8n / Zapier / Make workflow content (out of scope, ignore)
